expertise: The SwarmClaw MCP bridge retries once on -32601 (unknown tool) after cache invalidation and schema re-validation. Tests must assert the FINAL error code, not the first — a transient -32601 that clears on retry is a success path.

maskEnv(env?) masks ALL env values to *** before any env diagnostic is logged. It is the canonical P0.7 redactor — never write a bespoke one. PATH is always taken from the trusted parent process, never from a request-controlled env.

INV-SC2 command allowlist: npx packages must be in SWARMCLAW_NPX_PACKAGE_ALLOWLIST (default hindsight-local-mcp, @anthropic-ai/claude-code). Provenance flags (--registry/--userconfig/--cache/--cwd) are forbidden because they can redirect the allowlisted package name to an attacker-controlled source.
